race.description: Team Aidan Markets @ Crjc 22 November Hcp (C1)
race.comment: DOINGITEASY (4) produced solid figures second up from near last on the turn with a gritty second over 1310m at Lismore when shouldering the 59.5kg. Ready for the extra ground and can go one better here. STEADY ON (6) accounted for a Maiden field at start twelve with a game on-pace win over 1410m at this track. Gets an even better set-up today and stays in the calculations with the senior rider going aboard. REFEREES (1) holding his form and ready to peak fourth up. Closed strongly from an inside gate when fourth over 1420m at this track. Will go back from the draw and close late. SO SAIN (12) rewarded for her consistency with a tough on pace Maiden win over 1590m at Ballina. Gets a similar set-up again and must be kept safe.
